k:控.mnemonic: Your fingers (扌) reach up toward the sky (空), find nothing there to hold, and you pull the hand back in. Withdraw (draw in, hold back, refrain from).

k:粉.mnemonic: Grind rice (米) until each grain breaks into part (分) after part, too fine to count and soft as dust. Flour (powder, dust).
k:粉.hint: Grains ground too fine to count.

k:翻.mnemonic: When its turn (番) comes, the bird spreads its feathers (羽) and rolls right over in mid-air, belly to the sky. Flip (turn over, wave, flutter).

k:架.mnemonic: Add (加) one tree (木) trunk across the top of two others and you have put up the start of a building. Erect (frame, mount, support).

k:託.mnemonic: You hang your parcel on the carrier's fishhook (乙) and say (言), 'see that it gets there'. It is in his hands now. Consign (requesting, entrusting with, hint).
k:託.hint: Parcel hung on the carrier's hook.

k:趣.mnemonic: Take (取) the long speech and run (走) off with only the point of it. What was he actually driving at? Purport (gist, elegance, interest).
k:趣.hint: Running off with just the point.

k:傍.mnemonic: Someone with no rank (位) in the matter, forehead (冖) wrinkled, standing off to the side and looking in the direction (方) of the fuss. Bystander (side, besides, nearby).
k:傍.hint: Frowning onlooker off to one side.

k:墜.mnemonic: A pig (豕) slips off the top of the mound (阝) and lands with a thud in the soil (土) far below. Crash (fall down).

k:邸.mnemonic: The biggest house in the borough (阝), where the whole clan (氏) lives behind one great gate. Residence (mansion).

k:拘.mnemonic: One phrase (句), 'you are coming with me', and fingers (扌) close on your collar. Arrest (seize, concerned, adhere to).

k:琴.mnemonic: The king (王) claps his hands and demands music now (今). At once the player plucks the long strings. Harp (koto).

k:雷.mnemonic: Rain (雨) clouds gather over the rice field (田), and then comes a boom that shakes the water in the paddies. Thunder (lightning bolt).

k:刷.mnemonic: Carve the block with a knife (刂), ink it, press a towel (巾) of cloth down on it, and peel off a flag (尸) with the picture on. Then do it a hundred times. Printing (print, brush).
k:刷.hint: Peeling a picture off the block.

k:狭.mnemonic: The hound (犭) and the husband (夫) share one kennel-sized bed, and neither of them can turn over. Cramped (narrow, contract, tight).
k:狭.hint: Hound and husband in one bed.

k:肺.mnemonic: Spend a month (月) in the smoky city (市) and you feel it in your chest with every breath you take. Lungs.
k:肺.hint: Smoky city felt in the chest.

k:縦.mnemonic: The first thread (糸) on the loom hangs from top to bottom, and all the others accompany (従) it down, straight as plumb lines. Vertical (length, height).
k:縦.hint: Loom threads hanging top to bottom.

k:噴.mnemonic: A member (員) of the garden club shakes the fizzy bottle ten (十) times, and the cork flies off and soaks the flowers (艹). Erupt (spout, emit, flush out).

k:拓.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) pick stone (石) after stone out of the wild ground until there is a field that can be ploughed. Clear (the land) (open, break up land).
k:拓.hint: Picking stones out of wild ground.

k:閲.mnemonic: Elder brother (兄) stands at the gate (門) and looks over everyone's homework before it is allowed to leave the house. Review (inspection, revision).
k:閲.hint: Brother checking homework at the gate.

k:滞.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) water has nowhere to go. It sits in a pond as deep as your forehead (冖), still and green, with a lost towel (巾) floating in it. Stagnate (be delayed, overdue, arrears).
k:滞.hint: Still green pond with a towel.

k:尋.mnemonic: At the construction (工) site a man leans on his broom (ヨ) and opens his mouth (口): 'What is the measurement (寸) of this beam?' Inquire (fathom, look for).

k:虚.mnemonic: Tiger stripes (虍) painted on a skin and stretched above (上) a frame. Step behind it and there is no tiger, nothing at all. Void (emptiness, unpreparedness, crack).

k:珍.mnemonic: A king (王) with whiskers (彡) is common enough. But one who wears a plain straw hat (𠆢) instead of his crown? You might see that once in a lifetime. Rare (curious, strange).

k:滑.mnemonic: A skeleton (骨) tries to cross the floor left wet by the tsunami (氵), and its bony feet shoot out from under it. Slippery (slide, slip, fail exam).
k:滑.hint: Skeleton skidding on a wet floor.

k:貞.mnemonic: A fortune teller who will not take shellfish (貝) money to bend what the divining rod (卜) says. Upright (chastity, constancy, righteousness).

k:卓.mnemonic: Early (早) each morning his divining rod (卜) stands ready on the table, and it has never once been wrong. He towers over every other seer. Eminent (table, desk, high).

k:朗.mnemonic: A stubborn (艮) singer practises one song for a month (月), until every note rings out clear and bright. Melodious (clear, bright, serene).
k:朗.hint: A month's practice, every note clear.

k:偵.mnemonic: The leader (亻) pays a man in shellfish (貝) to creep about with a divining rod (卜), finding out what the enemy keeps hidden. Spy.

k:耐.mnemonic: A rake (而) built to exact measurement (寸). After years of stones and roots, not one of its teeth has bent. Enduring (-proof).

k:債.mnemonic: The leader (亻) signed for the money, so the blame (責) is his until every bit of it is paid back. Bond (loan, debt).
